source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.13 with Figure 12.11, printed page 284.

blocks.text: Sulfur ka bara hissa, taqreeban 85 feesad, sulfuric acid banane mein istemal hota hai. Molecule tetrahedral banawat rakhta hai jis mein do S-O (hydroxyl) aur do S=O bonds hain (Figure 12.11). Agle topics contact process se us ki tayyari, physical aur chemical khusoosiyat, aur istemalat bayan karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: H2SO4 ki banawat, S ke oopar do double bond wale O aur neeche do OH groups. Surkh dohre teer bond ki lambaiyan dete hain: S=O 142.2 pm, S-O 157.4 pm aur O-H 97 pm. Daen: ball-and-stick manzar, beech mein peela S, chaar surkh O aur neeche wale do O par do safed H.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.11: H2SO4 ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 12.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: S=O double bond (142.2 pm) S-O single bond (157.4 pm) se chhota hai, kyunke double bond mazboot hota hai aur atoms ko qareeb kheenchta hai. Chaaron O, S ke gird tetrahedral tarteeb mein hain, aur S ki oxidation state +6 hai.

blocks.prompt: Sulfuric acid ki banawat banayein aur us mein sulfur ki oxidation state dein (exercise Q.2j; MCQ IX).
blocks.explanation: Markazi sulfur chaar oxygens se tetrahedral taur par juri hai: do S=O ke taur par aur do S-OH. Hydrogen +1 aur oxygen -2 ke saath, 2 + S - 8 = 0, to sulfur +6 hai.

items: Taqreeban 85% sulfur H2SO4 mein jati hai; do S=O aur do S-OH bonds wala tetrahedral molecule; S +6 hai.
